5–15 dBi（2 单元约 6、3 单元 7–8、4 单元 8.5–9.5、6: 5–15 dBi (about 6 for 2 elements, 7–8 for 3, 8.5–9.5 for 4 and 10–11 dBi for 6)
VHF/UHF 全向，基地台与中继: Omnidirectional VHF/UHF, base stations and repeaters
从半波振子的一端馈电，对地网和架设高度不敏感；端馈阻抗在千欧量级，必须配 49:: Fed at one end of a half-wave element, it is insensitive to radials and mounting height; the end-fed impedance is in the kilohm range, so a 49:1 or 64:1 unun is mandatory.
全波环（周长约 1λ）约 3 dBi；测向用小环远低于 0 dBi: Full-wave loop (about 1λ in circumference) about 3 dBi; small direction-finding loops are far below 0 dBi
半波偶极两端下垂成倒 V，只需一根支撑杆，顶点宜在 0.25λ 以上；辐射略向上: A half-wave dipole with both legs sloping down into an inverted V: one support mast is enough, with the apex preferably above 0.25λ; radiation tilts slightly upward, covering both close-in work and DX.
半波辐射体加一根四分之一波长短路支节做匹配，不用地网、结构简单，常用于 2m/7: A half-wave radiator with a quarter-wave shorted stub for matching: no radials, simple to build, a standard 2 m/70 cm base antenna.
单元加倍约 +3 dB（同相合成）: About +3 dB each time the element count doubles (in-phase combining)
单根垂直导体，常见于手台和车台，便于携带与移动。手台的短橡胶天线效率很低，与车台: A single vertical conductor, common on handhelds and mobiles and easy to carry around. The short rubber duck on a handheld is very inefficient — not in the same league as a mobile antenna.
向所有方向均匀辐射的理想点源，现实中并不存在，只作为 dBi 增益的参考基准。: An ideal point source radiating equally in all directions. It does not exist in practice and serves only as the reference for dBi gain.
周长远小于波长的小型环天线，带宽很窄、需精细调谐。: A small loop far shorter than a wavelength in circumference: very narrow bandwidth, requiring careful tuning.
四分之一波长垂直振子加若干地网，全向、低仰角，俗称垂直天线；地网不足时增益会明显: A quarter-wave vertical element with several radials: omnidirectional and low-angle, commonly called a vertical; with too few radials the gain drops noticeably.
四根长导线拉成菱形、远端接电阻的行波定向天线，增益高、频带宽，但占地极大，只适合: Four long wires stretched into a rhombus with a resistor at the far end: a directional travelling-wave antenna with high gain and wide bandwidth, but it needs a huge plot of land and suits fixed stations only.
增益 = 方向性 × 效率。地面、导体与匹配网络的损耗都会降低效率——增益高的天: Gain = directivity × efficiency. Losses in the ground, the conductors and the matching network all cut efficiency — a high-gain antenna is not necessarily an efficient one.
多个单元按约 0.5–1λ 间距同相馈电：垂直堆叠压低仰角、水平排布窄化波束；单: Several elements fed in phase and spaced about 0.5–1λ apart: stacking them vertically lowers the take-off angle, placing them side by side narrows the beam; more elements mean a narrower beam.
天线近场边界约 r = 2D²/λ（D 为天线最大尺寸）。近场能量尚未完全形成辐: The near-field boundary is about r = 2D²/λ (D is the largest antenna dimension). Near-field energy has not fully formed into a radiated wave, so patterns and gain must be measured in the far field to be accurate.
导线绕成环状，方向性明显，常用于测向。周长 1λ 的全波环有约 3 dBi 方向: Wire bent into a loop, clearly directional and often used for direction finding. A full-wave loop of 1λ circumference has about 3 dBi of directivity; small DF loops are extremely inefficient and must not be quoted the same figure.
导线绕成螺旋，轴向模式辐射圆极化波、频带较宽，常用于姿态会变化的业余卫星通信。: Wire wound into a helix: in axial mode it radiates circularly polarised waves over a wide band, handy for amateur satellites whose attitude keeps changing.
总长约半个波长、从中间馈电的基础天线，输入阻抗约 73Ω。: A basic antenna about half a wavelength long, fed at the centre; input impedance is around 73 Ω.
把偶极两端连成回路的折合振子，输入阻抗约 300Ω，带宽明显宽于普通偶极，常用来: The dipole ends are joined into a loop, giving an input impedance of about 300 Ω and noticeably more bandwidth than a plain dipole — often used to cover a whole band.
把半波偶极竖直架设、从中间馈电，垂直极化、辐射仰角低，适合 DX；不需要地网，但: A half-wave dipole mounted vertically and fed at the centre: vertical polarisation and a low take-off angle suit DX; no radials are needed, but it must be mounted high.
振子长度和间距按比例递增，宽频带定向天线。: Element lengths and spacings grow in a fixed ratio: a wideband directional antenna.
接收天线把空间功率密度转换为可用功率的能力：Ae = G·λ² / (4π)。同: How well a receive antenna turns power density in space into available power: Ae = G·λ² / (4π). At the same gain, the higher the frequency the smaller the effective aperture.
接收系统灵敏度常用 G/T（增益 ÷ 系统噪声温度，dB/K）衡量；天线噪声温度: Receiver sensitivity is often quoted as G/T (gain divided by system noise temperature, dB/K); antenna noise temperature (sky, ground, losses) is often the dominant source of system noise.
有源振子加反射器与若干引向器组成的定向天线，增益高、前后比大（3–4 单元典型: A directional antenna made of a driven element plus a reflector and several directors, with high gain and a large front-to-back ratio (typically 15–20 dB for 3–4 elements, up to 25 dB in a good design); figures above 15 dBi usually mean a stacked array or a long UHF boom.
用抛物面反射器聚焦电波的高增益天线，用于微波和 EME。: A high-gain antenna that focuses waves with a parabolic reflector, used for microwave and EME.
电小天线 Q 值高、带宽窄（分数带宽约 1/Q）。缩小尺寸必然牺牲带宽与效率，这: Electrically small antennas have a high Q and narrow bandwidth (fractional bandwidth is roughly 1/Q). Shrinking an antenna always costs bandwidth and efficiency — the fundamental limit of small antennas.
端接的小型环形接收天线，用继电器切换端接方向即可换向，噪声低，专用于 160/8: A small terminated receive loop; switching the termination with a relay reverses its direction. Low noise, dedicated to 160/80 m reception.
约 -10~0 dBi（效率很低，视直径/波长比与工艺）: About -10 to 0 dBi (very inefficient; depends on the diameter/wavelength ratio and construction)
约 -25~-15 dBi（需低噪声前置放大）: About -25 to -15 dBi (needs a low-noise preamp)
约 0–3 dBi（理想导电地理论上限 5.15 dBi）: About 0–3 dBi (5.15 dBi is the theoretical ceiling over perfect ground)
约 2 dBi（顶点够高时）: About 2 dBi (when the apex is high enough)
约 2.15 dBi（与半波偶极相同）: About 2.15 dBi (same as a half-wave dipole)
终端接吸收电阻的宽带行波天线，没有自然谐振点、全 HF 段驻波平坦；代价是效率低: A wideband travelling-wave antenna with an absorbing resistor at the far end: no natural resonance and a flat SWR across HF; the price is low efficiency and a fair amount of space.
贴近地面、长数百米的单根行波导线，沿导线方向单向接收、噪声低，长度通常要一至数个: A single travelling-wave wire a few hundred metres long, close to the ground: it receives in one direction along the wire with low noise. It should measure one to several wavelengths and is used almost exclusively for reception.
车台 2–4 dBi；手台橡胶天线约 -5~0 dBi: Mobile 2–4 dBi; handheld rubber duck about -5 to 0 dBi
长度为多个波长的单根导线天线，架设简单。: A single wire several wavelengths long, simple to install.
阵列单元之间存在互耦，会改变各单元阻抗与方向图；间距过密耦合强、过疏易生栅瓣，通: Elements in an array couple to each other, changing their impedances and patterns; too close and the coupling is strong, too far apart and grating lobes appear, so 0.5–1λ is the usual spacing.
